snippet.title: Split Fiction | Official Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
See what the critics are saying about Hazelight’s new boundary-pushing co-op game Split Fiction! 

Packed with inventive co-op and unparalleled variety, this wild ride is waiting for you to jump in – and it's available now!

Invite a friend for free with the Friend's Pass* to enjoy the entire co-op adventure together! Remember, cross-play is enabled so you can play with someone on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, or PC.

Learn more about Split Fiction: https://www.ea.com/games/split-fiction/split-fiction 

*Friend’s Pass requires installation of the Friend’s Pass, persistent internet connection and applicable platform account. One user must own the full game in order for the co-op player to play the full game.
